corrections.reason: The printed glyph clearly has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) right-side stroke of 'ሁ' ('ሁኖ', matching line 28 below), not 'ሆ'.
In Ge'ez Acts 10:37 ('beginning from Galilee', glossed as 'ከገሊላ ፡ ጀምሮ' in line 32), the printed text reads 'አንዘ' (variant of አኀዘ/አንዘ), with 1st-order 'አ' and 6th-order 'ን', not 'እኒዘ'.
The printed text preserves the archaic Andemta form 'ሁነ' (with 2nd-order 'ሁ'), not 'ሆነ'.
